label: Opening Hook
text: Built 6,000 years before Stonehenge, this massive stone sanctuary proved human hunters organized societies long before farming began.
title: File:Unique engraving of a female on a stone slab from Göbekli Tepe, Urfa Museum.jpg

label: Terrain & Scale
text: Dating to 9500 BC—predating agriculture, pottery, the wheel, and metal tools Massive T-shaped limestone pillars weighing up to 20 tons carved with low-relief predators Overturned the classical archaeological timeline that farming preceded monument building Intentionally buried and backfilled with dirt thousands of years after construction Only an estimated 5% of the total underground temple complex has been excavated
